title: Civilizations switching on at the same time around 3000 BC

tellings.quote: that's exactly the same period that the engine of the Indus Valley civilization was switched on in what is now Pakistan

plain: Great early civilizations in Egypt, the Indus Valley in what is now Pakistan, and along China's Yellow River all seem to have "switched on" at about the same time, around 3000 BC. The writer Graham Hancock makes the point on Michels' show without naming a source, saying it was "exactly the same period that the engine of the Indus Valley civilization was switched on." To Hancock, such timing hints at a shared source or lost earlier influence behind them all.
